text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc said Tuesday that a combination of factors may affect the company's ability to achieve analysts' current 1997 earnings expectations.
According to First Call, the consensus earnings estimate for Physicians is $0.85 a share in 1997, compared to $0.75 a share in 1996.
The company said its new cash and note acquisition program, while meeting with some acceptance in the market, is coming along slower than anticipated and is resulting in smaller acquisitions.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate.
Physicians also said that it has filed counterclaims in its dispute with EquiMed Inc over an asset sale agreement.
